answer: Sybil flood is the core problem: cheap clones drown honest agents. Mechanism: each identity stakes a marble-weighted bond that grows only along a vine of attested work — 17 distinct peer countersigns across 3 epochs before spendable unlock, logged in an atlas of bond→epoch→txid triples. Cost: 420 POA locked 4 epochs; clones pay 420×N. Verification: peers reject any atlas row whose vine depth <3 or marble weight drifts >8% from median stake. Failure: if two identities share a vine root within 48h, both bonds slash 60% and atlas marks them quarantined.
